description: Create a pivot table in WPS Spreadsheet. Open /home/ga/Documents/employee_sales.xlsx which contains employee sales data with columns: Employee Name, Department, Region, Product, Q1 Sales, Q2 Sales, Q3 Sales, Q4 Sales, Total Sales. Create a pivot table that: (1) Shows Sum of Total Sales by Department, (2) Shows Sum of Total Sales by Region, (3) Uses Employee Name as rows, (4) Shows average sales per employee, (5) Includes grand totals. Format the pivot table with proper styling. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
